authority: Repository software, synthetic fixture and local simulator-generated historical observations; not authoritative KARDS rules
finding: No prior coverage contract distinguished comparable observation cells, deterministic evaluation pairs, repeated-game row counts or split-induced loss. Fixed game-disjoint holdouts can lose otherwise available row pairs.
change: Shared unchanged split algorithm; read-only coverage command with explicit seed or saved holdout; Train prints/persists pairCoverage, Verify recomputes it. Reports full/train/validation cells, row counts, unique games and pair losses without choosing a favorable holdout.

definitions.cell: ordered matchup ID and rounded raw global turn
definitions.deterministicPairs: sum(min(winRows,lossRows)) within cells, same denominator as ranking evaluation
definitions.rowsInComparableCells: all rows in cells containing both classes; not SGD update count
definitions.lostPairsBySplit: full pairs minus training pairs minus validation pairs
definitions.distinctGames: unique IDs behind observed rows; per-cell win/loss game counts included

regression.before: Unchanged HEAD Train/Save exercised with one new metadata assertion in existing ranking-metric selftest; failed because pairCoverage absent.
regression.after: 171 checks, both supported sampling modes, both pair and win targets, actual Train/Save/Verify/Coverage, null-pair/sparse/cross-split fixtures, exact seed algorithm, collision preservation, mismatched model contract and historical-runtime flag.

worker.verification: Primary independently recomputed every scope/cell field and source fixture hash. Worker code not executed or integrated; arithmetic agrees with hardcoded C# fixture.

historical.verification: Primary parsed all binary float records and exactly matched all three coverage scopes. This fixed five-game split holds out one game; per-game labels make within-holdout win/loss pairs impossible.

validation_environment.source: Clean HEAD src/BotSim/NNTrain plus four scoped sources; unrelated dirty action-probe changes excluded.

remaining: Training coverage diagnosis only; no card/native rule certification, statistical confidence or playing-strength measurement.

Observation pairs, including pairs from repeated same-game observations, are correlated; row pairs and SGD processed units are not independent matches. Counts report distinct game IDs but do not establish statistical independence.

Seeded splitting retains the original row-first distinct-game ordering and PRNG algorithm. It does not resample seeds, rebalance labels or repair sparse data. Reordering rows may change the seeded split; coverage counts for a fixed partition are order invariant.

The historical local dataset has a different simulator hash and is not current training data. Its binary and quality manifest are local unpublished evidence, recorded by hash; no claim that external readers possess those inputs.

Coverage validates Gate2 admission and row values/partition but does not add a complete binary-to-manifest semantic audit or verify game outcomes against the client. Output collision protection compares normalized path strings; filesystem aliases are not resolved.
Previous authority bindings are retained. PvP denominator and overall remaining percentage remain unresolved.
next_step: Predeclare a bounded collection schedule with repeated ordered matchups, multiple independent game seeds and a frozen game-disjoint holdout; measure Gate2 rejection causes and actual within-cell win/loss coverage before allocating a large training run. Do not weaken admission or search favorable labels/seeds.
